title: Restricted signed column projection commutes with differentials
statement: Let C be abelian admitting first-quadrant total complexes, let f:A to B be a morphism of such bicomplexes, and let F be a decreasing filtration of M=Cone(extend(Tot(f))) whose degreewise steps equal coneHorizontalStep f at every integer index and degree [lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable; def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For each natural p and integer n, put R_n=coneHorizontalProjection f p n [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection] and T=Cone(extend(f^{p,bullet}))[-p]. Then (F.step p).arrow^n followed by R_n followed by d_T^{n,n+1} equals d_{F.step p}^{n,n+1} followed by (F.step p).arrow^{n+1} followed by R_{n+1}. This concerns only the restricted explicit projection, without quotient invertibility.

source.place: First horizontal filtration and Lemma 12.25.1(1); column-cone refinement in lem-sp-cone-horizontal-graded-iso.

proof.text: Use the generator-vanishing theorem to show every source and target image in the finite supremum defining coneHorizontalStep f p n lies in the kernel subobject of the projection differential defect. Finset.sup_le and sup_le give containment of the entire tail in this kernel.

Use hF to identify the degreewise filtration step with this tail. Its inclusion factors through the kernel subobject, so its composite with the defect is zero. Distribute composition over subtraction to obtain the restricted differential equality, then use commutation of the filtration-step inclusion with differentials.

proof_origin.place: Kernel-subobject reduction of the restricted differential equation to the source and target generator calculations, refining the first-filtration formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_projection_differential
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    ((F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n) ≫
      ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).d n (n + 1) =
    (F.step (p : ℤ) : CochainComplex C ℤ).d n (n + 1) ≫
      (F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f (n + 1) ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p (n + 1)
